text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, considering the distance, I guess 
that makes sense. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next time, I'm definitely taking 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I already know what I did wrong, and I'll 
never run like that again."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, time to train! 
Let's go, let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no. Can you really look forward 
again that quickly?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, no matter how you look at it, 
you're the main character...
